name: Rising Angels: Reborn
source:
Despite brilliance and skill, Natalie Puccile, a Special Investigations and Tactics officer with the Katajion Directorship, has spent her career watching over a listening post in the middle of deep space. After the orders that she has always dreamed of finally arrive, she finds herself in charge of a small destroyer and tasked with discovering the fate of a missing research team investigating an ancient civilization. As situation falls apart around her, it is up to Natalie’s brilliance and the dedication of the crew of the KSS Nimross to avert a galaxy-shattering event that could spell the end of all space travel. With determination in her heart, Natalie rises to the chance to beat back the danger and perhaps find love in the twinkling lights of the distant stars.

[From [url=http://www.idhasstudios.com/?page_id=257]Official site[/url]]
translation:
尽管才华横溢、能力出众，卡塔吉翁总监署特殊调查与战术科的军官娜塔莉·普西尔，职业生涯一直都在深空中央的监听站值守。她梦寐以求的调令终于到来后，便接管了一艘小型驱逐舰，负责查明一支调查古代文明的研究队伍失踪的真相。周围的局势逐渐崩溃，娜塔莉的才智与KSS Nimross号全体船员的奉献，将决定他们能否阻止一场足以令整个银河系分崩离析、甚至终结一切太空旅行的事件。娜塔莉怀抱坚定的决心迎向这次机会，在遥远星辰的闪烁光芒中击退危机，也许还能寻获爱情。

[译自[url=http://www.idhasstudios.com/?page_id=257]官方网站[/url]]
